type Options = {reason: string};
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: Options) {
 for (const item of items) await step(item);
}
export const inOrderSteps = async <T,>(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], {reason}: Options) => {
 for (const step of steps) await step();
};
